answer.explanation: The live CompressionFunction config has MemorySize 128 MB and Timeout 3 s, but the IaC template specifies 1024 MB and 60 s. The function was last modified at 00:25:00Z, just before the window. Every invocation in the window (about 399 REPORT lines from 00:25:06 onward) ends with Status: timeout at Duration 3000 ms, so the 3 s limit is cutting executions short. Max memory used is about 91-98 MB, so memory is not the constraint; the short timeout is. The other three functions match the IaC template and show no drift. The IAM role was not implicated.
